### What the video shows
The 6.1s frame shows PRIMORDIAL PARADOX title art over a car on a road, the 18.4s frame is a near black starfield fade, the 30.6s frame shows crawl text about forgotten worlds on black, and the 42.9s, 55.1s and 67.4s frames are three identical stuck top down roadside views with a small blue sprite top left and no movement. I cannot hear audio or see the README or the repo from stills, and what a 3 minute demo would need is missing with no person talking to the game, no AI verdict in a textbox, no before and after or bake rows, no burned in captions explaining the claims, and none of the planned gate choice, dock office boarding, TALK fight, log save, game over or offline proof.

### The four scores
Impact, 2, no TALK interaction or verdict is visible and the last three frames are identical so the walk never reaches the dock and the player care claim is unproven.
Use of Meta AI tooling, 3, receipts list 21 model calls with 52.4 percent live but no NES textbox verdict, bake row or caption appears in any frame so no real work is visible.
Technical depth, 4, NES style art is visible but h264 stills cannot prove PPU limits and the log reports a dirty tree with 881 changed paths plus a failed Right walk input.
Demo, 2, the capture measures 73.5s which is 106.5s short of the planned 180s with 2 of 6 frames 90 percent one colour and three identical frozen frames with no captions.

### Five fixes, ranked
1. Unstick S5 walk so Right input reaches the dock office
Criterion: Demo, Lane: gamedev
Fix the S5 walk scene from Town Quay to the dock office so Right input moves the player sprite and restores the footstep cue that was missing in this capture. Update the input routing and walk script that left the 42.9s, 55.1s and 67.4s frames identical. A judge will see the sprite advance across frames in the video and hear footsteps before the boarding pass.

2. Show live Meta TALK verdict inside the NES textbox
Criterion: Impact, Lane: assistant
Wire the first TALK fight in S6 to the local AI bridge so a live Meta model verdict types into the NES textbox within hardware limits. Keep the bake row with receipt rcpt-a505930564032c7c visible alongside the 2408 char system prompt summary. A judge will see a player line judged on screen in the video and read the verdict without being told what to see.

3. Rebuild 180 second cut with burned in captions and bake rows
Criterion: Demo, Lane: builder
Rebuild output/demo/nightly-2026-11-11.mp4 to the full 180 second shot table S1 to S6 with the six verbatim captions burned in and the bake rows and network line drawn over S5 and S6. Render at the judged cadence and verify 180 seconds with audio before upload. A judge will follow title to crawl to drive to gate to walk to fights in the video and can share it without explanation.

4. Stage offline fallback fight with network down proof on screen
Criterion: Use of Meta AI tooling, Lane: testing
Stage the S6 offline shot with networking forced down so the game uses cached fallback rows from the 10 computed rows and shows the network line on screen. Log the result in data/receipts/meta_receipts.jsonl with measured versus computed labels preserved. A judge will see three bake rows plus the network line in the video while the fight still resolves.

5. Publish README limits page and clean tree to prove NES hardware fit
Criterion: Technical depth, Lane: audit
Add a README section that documents NES limits enforcement in code with engine module paths and how to check check_data and check_cleanroom passes. Clean the repo from HEAD 402643c7 with 881 dirty paths to a reviewable tree and exempt only generated geography cards. A judge will read the limits proof in the README and see the corresponding engine and receipt files in the repo.
